Definition: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner
BiblicalUsage: To meet is the word for encounters that change everything: a company of prophets met Saul and the Spirit came upon him, the Philistine arose and came and drew nigh to meet David, and Saul went out to meet Samuel as soon as the offering was done.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the meetings as the hinge of the story: Saul meets the prophets and prophesies, David meets Goliath and wins, Saul meets Samuel and loses the kingdom.
